shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts && git status --short && rg --files node_modules/next/dist/docs | head -100'

/bin/bash -lc "for file in pages/_app.js pages/_document.js pages/_error.js pages/404.js pages/index.js pages/blog/index.js 'pages/blog/[id].js' pages/api/posts/index.js 'pages/api/posts/[id].js' components/AppProvider.js styles/globals.css; do printf '\\n%s\\n' \""'$file"; cat "$file"; done'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"fetch('https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/posts?_limit=5').then(async r => console.log(r.status, (await r.json()).length)).catch(e => {console.error(e); process.exitCode = 1})\" && curl -sS --max-time 20 -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}\\n' 'https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap' && rg --files node_modules | rg '/(playwright|puppeteer)(-core)?/package.json"'$'"'"
/bin/bash -lc 'rmdir pages/api/posts pages/api pages/blog pages && npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && git diff --stat && rg -n 'next/(router|head|document|app)|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|isFallback|NextApi(Request|Response)' app components lib styles next.config.ts && true"
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff -- tsconfig.json package.json .gitignore && git status --short && rg --files app components lib tests'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"for (const name of ['playwright', '@playwright/test', 'puppeteer']) {try {console.log(name, require.resolve(name))} catch {console.log(name, 'not installed')}}\" && git diff --check && test "'! -d pages'
